text: The visible CLI contract requires explicit command and flag validation, global `--strict`, `--changed` only on incremental commands, finite `--profile` and `--mode` enums, output shaping via `--output`, `--fields`, `--limit`, and `--offset`, strict allowlist validation for `--capsule`, `--ref`, and `--certificate`, and repository-relative path validation for `--dataset`, `--candidate`, and `--baseline` that rejects absolute paths, traversal, control characters, and percent-encoding.
